changelog:
- Initial release of the marketing-memory skill.
- Enables AI agents to remember, store, and recall marketing campaigns and results using BlueColumn persistent memory.
- Supports storing campaign notes, recalling past campaigns, and searching marketing memory context.
- Requires a BlueColumn API key for access.
- Includes example API calls for storing, recalling, and noting marketing data.
summary: Give AI agents Remember campaigns and results. using BlueColumn persistent memory. Use when an agent runs marketing and needs campaign history; when the user wants to store, recall, or search marketing memory context. Requires a BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*).
